text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle got injured, so I immediately 
brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for making you worry. Still, I'm 
glad it wasn't anything serious.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I don't have time to stumble. I need to 
quickly repay what I've been given.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um... would it be all right if I did what 
I can? I just want to help out as much as 
possible.
choice_data_list: Let's take a rest, just in case.

Let's give it our best without overdoing 
it, shall we?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...You're right, if you think about it 
normally.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
But... I just... couldn't forgive myself 
for not trying my best...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah—I'm sorry! Even though you're only 
saying that for my sake, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'll get better soon and practice even 
harder than before!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though leaving behind positive words, K.S. 
Miracle walked away with a look of bitter 
frustration.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
! Thank you very much! I promise I won't 
cause you any trouble!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*, *gasp*――ugh! 
............Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, Trainer. Even though I 
pushed you to let me continue..."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I ended up causing trouble in the 
end. I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Encouraging the dejected KS Miracle, I 
headed back to the infirmary once again...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*, *gasp*―― Alright, with 
this...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Were you watching me?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I should be able to manage this level 
of training with no problem!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for believing in me. —I promise 
I'll live up to your expectations!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
K.S. Miracle continued training, keeping 
within reasonable limits.
